name: EPIC 249232203
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 15, 17.8 solar radii and 2.20 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_gal, EPIC 249232203 (K2 campaign 15): PARAM radius (solar radii) 17.769795 (16th-84th percentiles 16.872916-19.099121), MA09 pipeline with GALAH DR3

text.card: A red giant 5,068 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 2.20 solar masses and 17.8 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,681 K at its surface.
